name: skillmama
description: SKILLmama is a capability discovery system. SKILL.md is the agent-native implementation and the specification. The skillmama npm package provides a CLI (scan, check) and a programmatic runtime for the deterministic parts of that system. The shared deterministic rules are checked against SKILL.md by conformance tests.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/index.test.js test/detectors.test.js test/fixtures.test.js test/parsers.test.js test/scoring.test.js test/security.test.js test/search.test.js test/factors.test.js test/pipeline.test.js test/discovery.test.js test/skill-conformance.test.js test/cli-render.test.js test/cli-check.test.js test/cli-e2e.test.js
